failure_analysis: The model weights loaded successfully, but the measurement function assumed numerical candidate answers would each tokenize to exactly one token. In SmolLM2-135M, numeric tokens (e.g. '82', ' 82') tokenize to 2 or 3 tokens, triggering an immediate exception in the single-token assert.
status: Preserved original defect record; resolved by FIX-01 sequence-level teacher-forced scoring.
